name: One of Us
desc:
Welcome to One of Us.. 🔪

GAME IS IN ALPHA -- EXPECT BUGS.

Use Code "40KLIKES" for an in-game reward! 💰
Next Code at 50,000 Likes! 👍

Up to 6 players enter each match… but one of them hides a dark secret. 😈

One player is secretly the Killer, able to transform between human and monster form at will. Blend in with the group — or strike when no one expects it. Each Killer comes with a unique ability that changes how they hunt.

The rest are Survivors, who must:
⚙️ Repair all the generators to restore power
🕵️ Work together to figure out who the Killer is
🚔 Either call the police and survive until they arrive — or
🪵 Find a stake chest and take down the Killer themselves!

Trust no one. Every choice could be your last.
Will you survive the night… or become the next victim?

👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game to stay updated on all the latest features and improvements! ⭐

scripts.features:
This script was developed as a fun project to improve your gameplay experience. It comes with a complete set of visual, utility, automation, and progression features 🚀

👁️ Visuals & ESP
ESP Players lets you see all players through walls.
ESP Vents helps you instantly locate escape and movement routes.
ESP Items makes sure you never miss lootable items.
ESP Windows allows you to easily find entry and exit points.
ESP Generators helps you track objectives with no effort.
ESP Coins maximizes your gold farming.
ESP Chests specifically tracks wooden chests needed to craft weapons and take down the Killer.

⚔️ Automation & Combat
Aura Task automatically completes nearby tasks.
Aura Sabotage (Killer) automatically triggers sabotages for maximum chaos.
Anti-Trap prevents you from getting caught in Killer traps.

🛠️ Utility & Performance
Full Bright removes darkness and shadows for full visibility.
Anti-AFK prevents getting kicked for inactivity.
NoClip allows you to walk through walls and obstacles.
FPS Boost optimizes game settings for smoother performance.

💰 Progression Glitch (High Risk / High Reward)
Infinite Money & XP Bug is a powerful exploit that generates massive amounts of money and XP.

How it works: you must let the Killer down you or stand near a downed player. The script will trigger an infinite “save” loop.

⚠️ Important: this feature causes heavy lag. Do NOT use it like a normal option. Use it carefully.

🔒 Free vs Freemium Version (IMPORTANT NOTICE)
The FREE version no longer has access to the Infinite Money / XP bug and will NOT receive any further updates.

Only the FREEMIUM version, already available inside the Bug section of the script itself, will continue to receive updates and will include the Infinite Money / XP feature.

The free version is now limited and considered final / discontinued in terms of updates.

🔧 Executors & Compatibility
The script supports practically all executors, especially XENO.
On XENO, everything works perfectly except the Infinite Money bug ❌
XENO causes extreme lag on this feature, which breaks the code and makes it unusable.

✅ Best experience
Any paid executor works normally with all features.

🆓 Free executors
Velocity works perfectly with all features.
XENO works perfectly except for the Infinite Money bug.

📱 Mobile Support
The script has full mobile support and all features work.
The only issue on mobile is that the panel is very small, since the UI was made thinking only about PC 💻

To activate any function on mobile, just keep clicking on the option. After a few tries it activates, it’s not impossible 👍

📲 Infinite Money Bug on Mobile
When activating the Infinite Money bug on mobile, go to Roblox settings and enable “Tap to Move”.
This makes your character move by double-tapping the screen.

🚫 Playing like this is horrible, so only enable this setting when doing the Infinite Money bug. Do NOT keep using it like a normal feature.

📌 Best mobile executor
Delta is the best option and works perfectly.

📢 Attention
If you have any questions or problems, join my Discord and let me know so I can check and help 💬
